title: State and enforce every file budget in the gate

completion.statement: Every file budget is stated in CONTRIBUTING.md's File budgets table and enforced by validate.py constants at the subject commit: entry skill 150, non-entry skill 120, agents 60, descriptions 300 characters, canonical keys only, prose references 240, data/catalog/index references 320. Breaches fail the gate with the cap beside the measured value; a clean run prints the per-class maximum (entry 138, skill 86, agent 28, description 296, prose 195, data 127).
evidence: python3 scripts/validate.py (prints 'validate budgets: entry skill 138/150; non-entry skill 86/120; agent 28/60; description 296/300; prose reference 195/240; data/catalog/index reference 127/320')
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_tools.py (72 tests, incl. ValidateBudgetsTest seeded over-budget skill and reference fixtures)
SF_SKIP_NETWORK=1 bash scripts/check_all.sh (all run steps passed at the subject sha)
